summary: Stage and verify immutable Taskand shell runtime

delivery.outcome: Publish reproducible shell runtime staging and canary tooling, verify configured live provider, and deploy to the selected gateway with rollback.
nonGoals: Replacing a gateway before target selection

architecture.decision: Stage exact Git source and local dependency wheels outside checkout; isolate canary state; preserve existing runtime until target and catalog compatibility are established.
architecture.rollback: Stop canary and preserve previous release; any selected service switch records exact previous unit and restores it on failure.

validation.evidence: Staging rejection tests and real gateway/Paxlet canary; live provider receipt without credentials.
